name: button
title: Button
description: A raised control that lifts on hover and sinks when pressed.
use: An action in the page: save, open, confirm, toggle. One primary button per view; the rest stay plain or quiet.

instead.when: It goes to another page and reads as part of a sentence
It picks one of a few options that stay visible
It turns a setting on or off at once

keyboard.action: Activates the button, as the native element does

classes.name: btn-primary
classes.description: Ink on moonstone, pearl on obsidian: the main action of a view. With btn-danger it fills with the danger hue to confirm a destructive act

classes.name: btn-quiet
classes.description: No material until touched, for toolbars, headers and dense rows

classes.name: btn-brand
classes.description: The one hued control, filled from --color-brand; at most one per view

classes.name: btn-danger
classes.description: The danger ink on the label of a destructive action

classes.name: btn-square
classes.description: A square button for one icon; it needs an accessible name

classes.name: btn-group
classes.description: A container that joins its buttons into one shape

states.name: disabled
states.description: Or aria-disabled="true" on a link: a flat well with disabled ink

states.name: busy
states.description: Keeps its label, stops lifting; put a spinner beside the label

states.name: pressed
states.description: A quiet toggle that is on stays sunk into a well

states.name: current
states.description: A quiet button that is the current page stays sunk

properties.name: --btn-radius
properties.description: Corner radius: 10px, with 8px for small and 12px for large buttons

properties.name: --icon-size
properties.description: Size of an icon inside the button
